fact: AfDB communique says 935 km of terrestrial and under-river fibre were installed and made operational, as the first sections of the national backbone, along the Bangui-Douala road corridor (Bossembele, Yaloke, Baoro) to Berberati, with branches to Cameroon (Gamboula) and Congo (Bomassa); inaugurated 6 Feb 2023.

AfDB says that at project close in September 2023 the first national optical backbone was installed: 900 km of fibre with eleven technical sites, a network operations centre in Bangui and two community digital centres, linking CAR to Cameroon and Congo.

The Minister of Digital Economy praised Telecel Centrafrique for connecting to fibre optic in Bangui and in several interior towns, and said the first fibre deployments have begun while national connectivity remains fragmented; as_of is the 2025 year under review.

The Minister and Africa24 state 1,200 km of fibre optic is in place in CAR, with cross-border fibre taken from Congo at Ouesso and Cameroon at Kenzo; no regions or capital link are named. As_of is the article date.
